# jamfplatform_cbengine_benchmarks (Data Source)

Returns all Compliance Benchmarks from Jamf Pro. Requires **Compliance Benchmarks API** access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jamfplatform_cbengine_benchmarks" "all" {
}

output "all_cbengine_benchmarks" {
  value = data.jamfplatform_cbengine_benchmarks.all
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `benchmarks` (Attributes List) CBEngine benchmarks returned by GetCBEngineBenchmarksV2. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--benchmarks))
- `id` (String) Internal identifier for this data source read.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--benchmarks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `benchmarks`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Benchmark description, if provided.
- `id` (String) Benchmark identifier.
- `sync_state` (String) Current synchronization state reported by CBEngine.
- `target_device_groups` (List of String) Device groups targeted by the benchmark.
- `title` (String) Benchmark title.
- `update_available` (Boolean) Indicates whether an update is available for the benchmark.
